thread:
alex: FYI - after the RBAC cleanup, we're seeing intermittent mtls failures between services in ap-northeast and eu-west. Error sample: "tls: session_ticket_unwrap_failure: key_id mismatch".
priya: How widespread?
alex: ~0.4% across the mesh, but spikes to ~1.5% during rolling deploys. Happens when client resumes sessions issued in a different region.
ben: Suspect rotator KMS alias scoping. Did we change alias names to include region postfix?
rotator: We rolled ticket-key aliases to region-scoped names (e.g., session-ticket-eu-2026-03). Rotator instances use KMS:Encrypt/Decrypt scoped per-alias. Looks like some proxies in ap-northeast tried to unwrap eu tickets and got AccessDenied.
sre-oncall: Impact: higher tail latency and increased retries. No external errors yet, but internal queueing.
sec-bot: Triage: not a cryptographic vulnerability but an availability/RBAC issue. Audit gap: KMS unwrap failures are sampled out by our audit buffer if they originate outside central region. Need fix for both perms and logging.
alex: Immediate options: 1) grant cross-region kms:Decrypt for ticket aliases 2) disable session tickets for cross-region connections temporarily 3) change rotator to replicate aliases to all regions with consistent IAM.
priya: Quick mitigation = disable cross-region session tickets. Config idea for envoy: ```tls_context: { tls_parameters: { tls_min_version: TLSv1_3 }, session_ticket_keys: [], sni: "cluster.local" }``` That forces full handshake and avoids KMS unwrap on resume.
ben: Also add IAM patch: allow rotator-eu and proxy-ap-northeast service accounts kms:Decrypt on alias session-ticket-eu-* with Condition restrict RequestorService == "rotator" or "proxy". Keep narrow scope.
rotator: I'll deploy a canary: rotator will attempt a cross-region unwrap at startup and emit metric rotator.kms.unwrap.success/fail. If unwrap fails, we hot-fail the canary pod so we don't silently degrade.
sre-oncall: Good. We should also add telemetry fields to TLS logs: ticket_key_alias, unwrap_result, requestor_principal. Makes debugging fast.
sec-bot: Actionable items: - @rotator add canary unwrap metric & fail-fast (ETA 30m) - @ben prepare least-priv IAM JSON and backout (ETA 20m) - @alex push envoy disable-session-tickets for cross-region route (ETA 15m) - @priya enable audit-forward for KMS Unwrap/Decrypt events (ETA 1h).
ben: IAM snippet I'll use: ```{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Action": ["kms:Decrypt"],
  "Resource": "projects/rotator/keys/session-ticket-eu-*",
  "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"requestor:service": ["rotator","proxy"]}}
}```
priya: Also, search for any wildcard kms grants in the last 90d and alert if found. RBAC drift likely caused this.
rotator: Canary deployed - unwrap metric shows success in eu-west at 5265432180 but fails from ap-northeast at 5265432190. KMS logs show AccessDenied for principal proxy-apnortheast.
sre-oncall: Given that, let's apply the IAM patch to proxy-apnortheast role for that alias and restart 3 proxies as canary.
ben: Patch applied. KMS logs: Decrypt success from proxy-apnortheast at 5265432240. TLS handshake failure rate on canary drops to 0.02% at 5265432300.
sec-bot: Incident INC-2026-03-5265432100 created (tag: crossregion-ticket-rbac). Please attach KMS audit snippets and RBAC diff.
alex: Long-term notes: - replicate alias metadata + key policy across regions automatically - prefer delegating ticket wrapping to a central signing service and issue short-lived delegation tokens to proxies so they don't need Decrypt permissions for remote aliases - add CI test that simulates cross-region KMS denies.
priya: Also add a policy lint that flags removals of kms:Decrypt/Encrypt from roles owning ticket ops. Prevents future regression.
rotator: Rolling full fix: replicate aliases and apply least-priv grants to rotator/proxy roles. Will follow up with PR.
sre-oncall: If error rate >1% after fixes, escalate to P1.
alex: Thanks team, will update incident doc and schedule postmortem focusing on alias replication and RBAC drift detection. :thumbsup:
